summary: 2018 excavation (Roland Enmarch) found a ramp cut into rock at the Hatnub alabaster quarry with a steeper-than-expected slope (>20%, vs prior estimates that ramps didn't exceed 10%), dating to the Great Pyramid's era.
content: In 2018, Dr Roland Enmarch... and his team made a breakthrough by discovering a ramp cut into rock at a quarry at Hatnub... The angle of the ramp was more extreme than expected, with a slope of more than 20 per cent (previous estimates suggested that ramps in Ancient Egypt wouldn't have exceeded 10 per cent). ... suggesting that a similar ramp could have been used in its construction.
